div.head: Announcements
div.p: Terlan’s graduation: Our warmest congratulations to our dear colleague, who has been with us since the start of the project and who, on 28 May, successfully defended her thesis and completed her PhD.
The WIBARAB team would like to thank you for all the wonderful moments we’ve shared with you and wish you all the very best for the future.

Terlan’s doctoral thesis: We are thrilled to announce that our dear colleague Terlan, who has been involved in the project from the very beginning, has completed and submitted her doctoral thesis on the grammar of the Bedouin-type dialects of the Zaer and Chaouia in Central Morocco. It is the first dissertation to be completed as part of the project. Our warmest congratulations!
We would like to express our sincere thanks to Terlan for the wonderful years we spent working together on the project and wish her all the best for the future!

Stanley’s graduation: Another member of the WIBARAB team has successfully completed his studies with his thesis on the Arabic dialect of the Rashayda in Sudan. The team would like to congratulate Stanley on his graduation and wish him all the best for the future!

Veronika’s graduation: We are very happy and proud to announce that our dear colleague Veronika Engler has graduated with her thesis on the TEI-based WIBARAB database. On behalf of the entire team, we would like to extend our heartfelt congratulations and wish Veronika all the very best.
